model_contract.call_wall: strike with maximum aggregated positive Call GEX
model_contract.expected_move: nearest-expiry ATM-near call mid + put mid; never VIX-derived
model_contract.gamma: Black-Scholes gamma from chain impliedVolatility, observed short Treasury rate, q=0
model_contract.gamma_flip: aggregate GEX zero crossing on spot grid; linear interpolation; nearest valid crossing to spot
model_contract.put_wall: strike with minimum signed Put GEX

ordering: Data quality then total OI; not a directional ranking because legacy Direction/Confidence producer is unrecovered.
source: Yahoo Finance option chains via yfinance 0.2.66; recovered V38 GEX/Wall/Flip/Expected-Move contract

target_policy.method: Core12 first, then RS189 leaders, then highest DDV20; deterministic cap
target_policy.note: Legacy options_targets producer was not recovered; this target policy is explicitly separated from the final ranking rules.
